protocol.scope: Acquisition, hooks, packaging, retention and creative experimentation for local-service demand generation.
protocol.inclusion: Primary platform guidance or directly attributable creator material with a stable URL.
protocol.exclusion: Unsourced summaries, popularity rankings and claims of causal lift without an A7 test.
protocol.freshnessRule: A source without a verifiable publication or update date is marked potentially_outdated.

findings.title: Performance 5: Creative diversification
findings.claimSummary: Meta recommends creative diversification so the delivery system can match distinct messages and formats to people.
findings.limitation: Platform guidance does not prove that eight variants improve A7 sales, and the page has no verified publication date.
findings.a7Translation: Test strategically distinct territories, not cosmetic variants; keep each wave small enough to learn at the current budget.

findings.title: Simplify your ad set structure
findings.claimSummary: Meta recommends consolidating similar ad sets so learning is not fragmented.
findings.limitation: This is delivery guidance, not evidence that any specific creative will produce conversations or sales.
findings.a7Translation: Use one control and at most two challengers per wave; do not launch all eight hypotheses together.

findings.title: Measure key moments for audience retention
findings.claimSummary: Audience-retention reporting separates the intro, spikes and dips so creators can diagnose where attention is gained or lost.
findings.limitation: Video retention is an attention signal, not a sale or proof of local-service demand.
findings.a7Translation: Treat first-frame hold and completion as creative diagnostics while keeping WhatsApp conversations and reconciled sales separate.

findings.title: How YouTube recommendations work
findings.claimSummary: YouTube describes appeal, engagement and satisfaction as distinct groups of signals used to understand content performance and recommendations.
findings.limitation: Recommendation signals belong to YouTube consumption and do not establish local-service demand, a WhatsApp conversation or a sale.
findings.a7Translation: Diagnose whether a concept earns attention, sustains it and satisfies the viewer without collapsing any of those signals into commercial conversion.

findings.title: TikTok Creative Codes
findings.claimSummary: TikTok packages short-form creative as hook, body and close, and reports that the first six seconds account for 90% of ad-recall impact.
findings.limitation: The reported result concerns recall in TikTok's research, not qualified conversations, sales or incremental revenue for A7.
findings.a7Translation: Give every short-form concept an immediately legible opening, a concrete service body and one explicit WhatsApp close; validate commercial quality separately.

findings.title: Creative strategy frameworks
findings.claimSummary: Motion presents creative territory as combinations of customer persona, pain, awareness and angle to structure diversity and analysis.
findings.limitation: Motion sells creative analytics software; its framework is commercially motivated and does not causally validate a taxonomy or media result.
findings.a7Translation: Use persona × pain × awareness × angle as an anti-copy signature, then require an explicit strategic difference and A7 evidence.

findings.title: $100M Leads
findings.claimSummary: The material argues that the offer and its value proposition precede lead-generation mechanics.
findings.limitation: This is creator/vendor guidance, not independent causal evidence; A7 must test whether a clearer offer improves qualified demand and contribution.
findings.a7Translation: Make the operational offer concrete before optimizing hooks, while preserving documented price, availability and attribution boundaries.

findings.title: MrBeast: Future of YouTube, Twitter, TikTok, and Instagram
findings.claimSummary: Jimmy Donaldson describes packaging, immediate clarity and retention as engineered parts of content performance.
findings.limitation: Long-form entertainment at massive scale is not a causal model for a small Orlando laundry service.
findings.a7Translation: Borrow the discipline of an instantly legible promise and visual progression, then validate it against qualified conversations.

findings.title: A7 Communication Ecosystem
findings.claimSummary: Paid, feed and stories use native formats and converge on human WhatsApp support.
findings.limitation: Internal operating doctrine is a testable hypothesis, not independent evidence of incremental sales.
findings.a7Translation: Design each territory for a native surface and use conversation as a distinct stage before sale.

findings.title: Meta creative production standard
findings.claimSummary: Paid eligibility requires safe-zone compliance and previews for six placements.
findings.limitation: Production correctness does not establish commercial performance.
findings.a7Translation: A brief may enter production, but paid_challenger remains an internal eligibility state until preflight and explicit authorization.
